hook.whyItWorks: A huge protein number over a table packed with about 20 glass containers stops the scroll before a word lands. Under it he opens with a self-deprecating joke about his height (partly unclear on the audio), which makes a numbers-heavy video feel friendly.

format.reasoning: The spread is the hook, so he keeps it in frame the whole time and talks through it. App screenshots back up the numbers, and promising to break each recipe down later in the week builds a series and gives people a reason to follow.

myVersion.hook: [X] grams of protein a day, fully vegetarian, all desi food. This is my whole week.
myVersion.script:
[X] grams of protein a day, fully vegetarian, all desi food. This is my whole week.
And yes, I'm short. You'll see more dabbas than me in this video.
So here's the plan.
Mornings start with my chai. Non-negotiable.
Breakfast is moong dal chilla with paneer stuffing and a bowl of curd. I make the batter on Sunday so it's ready every day.
Mid-morning, Greek yogurt or hung curd with fruit and some roasted seeds on top. That one surprised me with how much protein it has.
Lunch is the big one. Chole, a small portion of rice, and kachumber on the side. Cooked once, portioned into five boxes.
Evening snack is a handful of roasted chana and a buttermilk. Cheap, filling, easy to carry. It goes in my bag every single day, so I'm never stuck buying samosas at five o'clock.
Dinner is my favourite this week. Paneer tikka bowls. Grilled paneer, peppers and onion, a little brown rice, mint chutney on top.
I tracked everything in an app so I know the numbers are real for my portions.
Calories are set for fat loss, not a bulk. I'm eating a little less than I burn, steadily, week after week. Your numbers will be different, so don't copy mine blindly.
Over the week I'll post each recipe with the exact quantities.
Which box are you making first? Tell me below.
Follow @fitwithbhavika for more.
